title: Book Two · Chapter 54: The Red Cup
story:
On Friday morning, Miss Wu gives each child a short page. Ronan keeps both hands on his desk until his paper arrives.

The title is The Red Cup. Under it, a woman stands beside a table. A boy holds an empty tray. There is no cup in the picture.

Ronan reads the first line. The woman puts milk in a red cup for her son. The boy carries the cup toward the table. His little sister runs across the room. He stops near a chair. Some milk spills on his hand.

Ronan looks at the questions. Where does the boy put the cup? He wants to write table. There is a large table in the picture. He moves his pencil toward the answer space.

Then he sees the next line of the story.

The boy puts the cup on the chair. He wipes his hand. The woman moves the cup from the chair to the high shelf. Then she cleans the floor.

Ronan brings his pencil back. The question asks about the boy. It does not ask about the woman.

He writes chair.

The next question asks about the milk on the floor. Ronan reads the little sister's part again. She runs past, but she does not carry the cup. He writes a short answer about the boy.

He reads the last question. In his answer, he writes that the cup is empty. He checks the last line. The mother cleans the floor. Then she gives her son the cup again. Some milk is still inside.

Ronan draws one line through empty. Below it, he writes some milk.

Leo puts down his pencil. A chair moves at the back of the room. Ronan hears it, but he stays with his page until Miss Wu asks for the papers.

He gives her his page. His first answer still has a line through it. It looks less neat than Leo's paper. He wants to explain the change. Miss Wu goes to the next row for more papers. Ronan says nothing.

At break, Jun asks about the cup.

“I nearly put it on the table,” Ronan says.

“I put it on the chair.”

“I did too. But I nearly emptied it.”

Jun looks confused. Ronan tells him about the last answer. Jun laughs and pretends to drink from a small cup.

“Good. Some milk for me.”

They go outside. Near the steps, a child drops a real water cup. It rolls toward the lower step. Ronan stops it with his foot. He gives it back. There is no water left in that cup at all.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

cup＝杯子；empty＝空的；spill＝洒出。

## 理解问题

1. 故事中的杯子为什么不在桌上？
2. Ronan交卷前改了什么？

## 读句子

**He / checks / the last line.** 他／核对／最后一行。
